explanation: It is 0 everywhere except the GO step when the agent chooses a2 and the previous trial was rewarded after one or more unrewarded trials: 10 if the reward broke a run of two or more losses, about 6 if it followed a single loss, and about 2-3 on the GO right after (a second reward in a row), then back to 0 with longer reward streaks. It is always 0 at D1, at D2 and on a1 choices, and it is strongest in trials 25-60 of the episode, only about 1-5 later on.
